title.en: An Act Establishing a National High School in Barangay Callao Norte, Municipality of Lasam, Province of Cagayan, to Be Known as the Callao Norte National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Establishing a National High School in Barangay Callao Norte, Municipality of Lasam, Province of Cagayan, to Be Known as the Callao Norte National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia tại Barangay Callao Norte, Thị trấn Lasam, Tỉnh Cagayan được biết đến với tên gọi Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia Callao Norte
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ Callao Norte, เทศบาล Lasam, จังหวัด Cagayan ให้เป็นที่รู้จักในชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติ Callao Norte
title.id: Undang-Undang mendirikan Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional di Barangay Callao Norte, Kotamadya Lasam, Provinsi Cagayan dikenal sebagai Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional Callao Norte
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan di Barangay Callao Norte, Perbandaran Lasam, Wilayah Cagayan dikenali sebagai Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan Callao Norte

text.en: The Department of Education, Culture and Sports shall establish a national high school in Barangay Callao Norte, Municipality of Lasam, Province of Cagayan.

The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be funded out of the appropriations authorized by Republic Act No. 7663 for the Department of Education, Culture and Sports intended for the operational expenses of newly legislated high schools. Thereafter, the amount needed for its operation and maintenance shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
